description: This file contains localization strings for the Select2 library in Brazilian Portuguese, providing translated messages for various UI states and validation messages.

methods.name: errorLoading
methods.description: Returns a message indicating results could not be loaded.

methods.name: inputTooLong
methods.description: Returns a message prompting the user to delete extra characters when input exceeds the maximum allowed.

methods.name: inputTooShort
methods.description: Returns a message prompting the user to input more characters when input is below the minimum length.

methods.name: loadingMore
methods.description: Returns a message indicating more results are being loaded.

methods.name: maximumSelected
methods.description: Returns a message indicating the maximum number of selections allowed.

methods.name: noResults
methods.description: Returns a message indicating no search results were found.

methods.name: searching
methods.description: Returns a message indicating the search is in progress.
